_how_to_edit: Add, remove or reword prompts in any list. Changes apply to the next card dealt, no restart needed (if an edit has a typo, the game keeps the last good version and warns in the terminal). Everyone holds 3 cards, so keep at least ~4 'light' prompts per guest. The host unlocks 'warm' from the tablet; 'deeper' only appears if turned on in Settings. Optional extras: 'tonight' is a list of prompts you write for this event; they show up when the host taps ✎ on the tablet (check prompts about the couple with them first). 'skip' lists prompts not to deal at this event without deleting them.
